incident-bot: ⚠️ Incident opened: HIGH latency spike observed in prod inference cluster (p95/p99 breaches). Paging eng-oncall. Cmd: /incident create KV_CACHE_PRESSURE

alice (oncall): seeing p95 jump from 120ms -> 850ms and p99 ~2.1s for text-generation routes in eu-west-1. Streaming stalls reported.

ben (infra): confirming elevated eviction rate on kv-shards: eviction_rate ~ 18k/min (baseline ~1k). Cache slab fragmentation visible.

carmen (runtime): logs show prefill Q depth spiking and decode workers backlog. Looks like prefill vs decode imbalance — many small prefill keys evicting hotspots.

alice (oncall): customer-facing impact? any API error spike or only latency?

elaine (cust-succ): CS reports 3 customers with increased tail latencies and one reported UX spinner for chat flows (enterprise account). No 5xxs so far.

ben (infra): metric snippets: `kv.prefill.requests/min = 24k`, `kv.decode.ops/min = 6k`, `kv.slab.free_pct = 4%`, `evictions.total = 1.2M last 10m`.

carmen (runtime): streaming stall traces attached: many requests hitting prefill misses then falling back to decode, causing KV hot shards to thrash. Decoders queue up, streaming tail stalls at ~300-600ms extra.

alice (oncall): quick mitigation options: 1) throttle prefill for chat-heavy routes, 2) increase slab allocation to shard pool, 3) route traffic to eu-central fallback pool. Thoughts?

ben (infra): can bump slab size for affected shard group (hot) — `svc-kv scale-slab --shard hot-42 --pct 150` — that should reduce immediate evictions. Doing right now, ETA ~90s.

infra-bot: Job queued: scale-slab hot-42 -> 150% (op id: op_987654). Estimated completion: 70s.

alice (oncall): also enabling short-term prefill suppression for chat route: `runtime-toggle --route /v1/chat --prefill=false --duration 10m` — Carmen, can you flip?

carmen (runtime): Doing toggle now. Will monitor decode queue.

ben (infra): slab scale applied. `op_987654` succeeded. Free_pct rose to 12% within 30s. Eviction_rate down to ~2.8k/min.

carmen (runtime): prefill suppression applied. Decode Q dropped by ~40% in the first minute. Streaming stalls p95 improving from 850ms -> 220ms. p99 trending down.

alice (oncall): good, visible improvement. Customer spinner reports should reduce. Elaine, please notify the affected customer that we're investigating and that a temporary mitigation is in place; will follow up with RCA.

elaine (cust-succ): on it — drafting note: informing them about transient latency due to cache eviction, temporary mitigations applied.

dave (sre): we should still schedule a controlled slab compaction and run slot rebalancer to reduce fragmentation. Also want to add guardrail: circuit-break prefill surge if prefill:decode ratio > 3 for > 60s.

ben (infra): agree on automation. I'll open infra task to add surge-protection rule. For immediate safety I can add a temporary autoscale for decode pool +30% to clear backlog. Apply?

carmen (runtime): please do. Decode autoscale +30% should reduce tail quickly and avoid reintroducing stalls when we re-enable prefill.

ben (infra): started decode autoscale. New pods coming up.

infra-bot: Autoscale event: decode-pool +30% (grp: decode-eu-west). Pods healthy.

alice (oncall): monitoring shows p95 ~180-210ms, p99 ~720ms and decreasing. Marking incident as mitigated but not resolved.

incident-bot: Severity downgraded -> MEDIUM. Attach playbook: `kv-eviction-frag-triage`.

alice (oncall): short action items: 1) infra to implement prefill surge guard (ben), 2) runtime to plan slab compaction + slot rebalancer runbook (carmen), 3) SRE to prepare postmortem template and customer impact timeline (dave), 4) CS follow-up with customers (elaine).

ben (infra): will file infra ticket and link to this thread. ETA for rule PR: 6h.

carmen (runtime): I'll schedule controlled compaction tonight during low traffic window and run-slot-rebalancer in staging first.

dave (sre): I'll start the incident report draft with timestamps and SLO breach windows. Will include p95/p99 charts and the eviction metrics.

elaine (cust-succ): Sent interim updates to customers. They asked for ETA on full fix — I'll tell them ETA 24-48h pending infra runbook.

alice (oncall): handoff to jm for night oncall. jm, please take watch and follow up on PR merges, compaction run, and customer comms if needed.

jm (oncall-next): taking it. I'll monitor p99 and decode queue, and ping if any rollback needed.

alice (oncall): final: incident pinned, mitigations applied, customers notified. We'll reconvene for RCA tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated. Channel: eng-oncall.
